scope: Targeted primary-source review of the two concrete post-CR20 proposals shared by response_review. No GPU, source edits, paper edits or frozen edits.

closed_rationale.result: The accepted two-model review finds seven primary predicates satisfied at both resolutions; row4 is native-violated/high-resolution-unjudgeable. No primary native-success/high-resolution-failure case was found. Kneeling improves at4K; only auxiliary Paradis lettering regresses.
closed_rationale.consequence: Close this particular semantic-loss premise on these eight observations. It neither refutes all resolution research nor supports promoting the remaining lettering example into an OCR project. This note reads the accepted review artifact; it does not constitute a third image reviewer.

candidate1.name: Mass-preserving image-to-text phase remapping
candidate1.specific_operator: Keep all image logits b and values fixed. Replace text logits a by native-reference phase logits a_prime from the same content vectors, then set a_tilde=a_prime+LSE(a)-LSE(a_prime). This changes only text conditional probabilities while preserving their partition mass. Restrict the first diagnostic to image queries; reverse text-to-image editing is a separate intervention.
exact_real_arithmetic_properties: The text partition function, total text probability m, image weights and image weighted-value contribution are unchanged.
Output change is m times the change of the text-only normalized value average.
Output-change norm is bounded by m times the diameter of the text values. Large conditional KL at tiny m may produce little full-output change.
candidate1.mathematics_status: Partition-mass normalization, softmax block decomposition and these identities are elementary. They are not new theorems or novel algorithmic ingredients.
candidate1.remaining_specific_distinction: A frozen diffusion backbone with deployed image-image geometry and exactly fixed modality mass, changing only image-to-text phases toward one declared reference coordinate grid. No identical complete operator was located in this targeted source check. That is a narrow composition distinction, not proof of novelty or usefulness.
premise_limits: Grid64x64 is the project1024 reference, not a verified hard upper bound of the training coordinate support. Do not label every coordinate beyond63 unseen during training.
Phase sensitivity is not evidence of harmful bias. The proposed reference can increase or decrease useful conditional odds depending on content.

CR20 supplies no observed primary semantic failure to repair. This CPU investigation asks whether a distinct operator exists and has measurable leverage, not whether it solves the rejected semantic premise.
implementation_limits: A single shared image-Q/K positional transform generally cannot alter cross-modal phases while preserving every image-image logit; separate block computation or equivalent correction is needed.

Normalized SDPA output alone does not expose original text mass. Full deployment needs a global log-normalizer from the attention kernel or extra reduction, plus text-only attention work. No latency claim follows from inexpensive selected-query CPU analysis.

Pair-equal gains commute with rotary rotations in real arithmetic. Inverting saved BF16 post-RoPE vectors recovers a surrogate, not exact original pre-RoPE activations. Same-coordinate reconstruction must be reported separately.

independent_tiny_cpu_check.description: One2D rotary pair, q=[1,0], text keys e1/e2, old angle2 and new angle0.5; two fixed image logits0.2,-0.3. Float64 Python math.
independent_tiny_cpu_check.interpretation: Verifies controllability and algebra only. No preferred semantic outcome is assigned to either token.

closest_primary_collisions.title: Phase-Aligned RoPE for Mixed-Resolution Diffusion Transformer
closest_primary_collisions.mechanism: Section4.1 PMA, formerly referred to as CRPA, remaps key positions separately for each query scale. Equation8 uses the relative phase alpha_(k_to_q)*p_k-p_q. LR queries also use strided HR keys.
closest_primary_collisions.difference: This concerns mixed-resolution image/video token groups, not an image-to-text-only transport with image logits and text mass fixed. It does not certify our nominal64-coordinate target.

closest_primary_collisions.title: Circle-RoPE: Cone-like Decoupled Rotary Positional Embedding for Vision-Language Models
closest_primary_collisions.mechanism: Maps image coordinates to an annulus orthogonal to the text axis to reduce cross-modal positional coupling, and alternates that geometry with ordinary grid encoding across layers. Section5.1 updates the VLM language component during training.
closest_primary_collisions.collision: Separating cross-modal positional geometry from intra-image geometry is established.
closest_primary_collisions.difference: No preservation of the deployed image-image logits or text partition mass is shown. Its expected-kernel geometric argument has assumptions and is not a universal theorem about actual FLUX logits.

closest_primary_collisions.title: Untwisting RoPE: Frequency Control for Shared Attention in DiTs
closest_primary_collisions.mechanism: Section5 and Equation10 apply frequency-dependent amplitude scales only to reference-image keys; target image keys, text keys and queries remain unchanged. The paper also tests disabling RoPE for reference attention and reports artifacts.
closest_primary_collisions.collision: Selective rotary-channel manipulation limited to a token group is established.
closest_primary_collisions.difference: Reference-image style transfer and amplitude modulation are different from image-to-text phase remapping with fixed text mass. A claim that selective RoPE editing itself is new would be false.

closest_primary_collisions.title: Rethinking Cross-Modal Interaction in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
closest_primary_collisions.mechanism: TACA Equation10 scales visual-text logits by gamma while leaving visual-visual logits unchanged; Equation11 schedules gamma by timestep. It adds LoRA tuning to reduce artifacts from the changed output distribution.
closest_primary_collisions.collision: Modality-specific adjustment already changes relative text-token odds, unlike a common additive bias. Thus changing within-text odds is not by itself a distinction.
closest_primary_collisions.difference: Temperature scaling does not rotate content directions and generally changes total text mass. The proposed mass-preserving phase intervention has a different controlled target; useful efficacy remains unmeasured.

candidate2.name: Expectation of normalized native-cardinality random subsets
candidate2.status: Do not promote as a new mechanism from the expectation/normalization distinction alone.

primary_collision.title: DropKey for Vision Transformer
primary_collision.mechanism: Drops keys before softmax, so retained attention is renormalized within each random subset. The paper studies regularization, layer schedules and structured dropping.
primary_collision.boundary: Training-time stochastic key masks differ from a fixed-cardinality stratified inference expectation, but the central normalized-random-subset operator is established.

candidate2.known_math: E[N_S/Z_S] generally differs from E[N_S]/E[Z_S]. Naming that difference is not an independent justification for native-cardinality attention.

independent_enumeration.interpretation: The expectation is a different target; it is not a dense-attention estimator. At one key per uniform subset it becomes the mean value and ignores query affinity. This supplies a concrete falsifier against an unconditional semantic-benefit claim.

candidate2.conditional_future_value: Only a separately justified target for cardinality, stratification and desired bias, with equal-cost comparisons, could turn this into a useful refinement. No such evidence is supplied by CR20.

recommended_bounded_cpu_unit.choose: Candidate1 only, using the already accepted CR19 saved Q/K/V and fixed selected queries. No new capture or GPU generation is needed.
freeze_before_reading_results: One coordinate convention and native-frequency rule, including endpoint mapping versus pixel-center mapping.
Image-to-text only; leave image-image and text-query behavior unchanged in this diagnostic.
Original, same-coordinate inverse/forward roundtrip, changed phase without mass correction, changed phase with mass correction, and a mass-preserving temperature-only comparison.
Preserve all declared prompts, heads, blocks and queries without choosing a favorable subset.
measure: Native-grid identity on exact toy pre-RoPE tensors and no-op numerical floor on saved BF16 tensors.
Text mass, conditional KL/total variation, mass-weighted full-distribution change and full output delta.
Whether the phase correction is materially non-collinear with simple temperature reweighting on the captured logits. This establishes operator distinction only.
recommended_bounded_cpu_unit.scientific_interpretation: A nonzero distinct perturbation supports actuator availability, not correctness, semantic benefit or image quality. A null perturbation or a correction at the reconstruction floor is useful negative evidence. Any later GPU intervention requires an independently justified endpoint and cost comparison rather than a return to the closed CR20 relation-loss rationale.

search_limits: Targeted full-method reading of PMA, Circle-RoPE, UntwistingRoPE and TACA plus the primary DropKey proceedings page. Not an exhaustive prior-art search; no author-reported benchmark was reproduced. The new candidates do not establish a local-texture or geometry failure merely by changing labels.
